UP CM disburses ₹148 crore scholarship to 4.6 lakh students

Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has disbursed ₹148 crore in scholarships to 4.60 lakh students. The scholarship funds were sent directly to the students' bank accounts. In Chanduali, scholarship acceptance letters were distributed with a live broadcast.
